Taxes and fees at St. Augustine hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at Regency Inn & Suites to 15% at 1001 Nights Bed and Breakfast. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
